message: You know that feeling when you realize you’ve never actually read the instructions for your fire extinguisher? 🙈 It’s kind of like preparing for a surprise party you didn’t know you were throwing! This resource is a great reminder to brush up on some essential safety skills in a fun way. I love the idea of turning preparedness into a light-hearted family activity — we might even laugh a little while we’re at it! What’s your favorite tip for getting ready without the stress?
